fanLanding.heroSubtitle: Share your heart and earn supporter-only perks and a founding badge. The more you back, the closer you get.

how.step1Body: Discover creators to back by browsing or searching.

benefits.messageBody: Send mochi with a message and reach the creator directly.

fanLanding.mochiExplainerBody: There is no refund of value, resale, or financial return. What you receive is the creator's gratitude, supporter perks, and your status as a fan (badges and ranking). It is never shown as a balance or a value.
fanLanding.creatorPromptBody: Turn your fans' support into a Trust Report you can show to sponsors.
fanLanding.finalCtaBody: The warmest way to reach a creator you love.

creatorLanding.heroSubtitle: Turn the support your fans send as mochi into one Trust Report each month. Prove a real fandom to brands, sponsors, and MCNs.
creatorLanding.insightTitle1: Sponsors look past view counts to
creatorLanding.insightBody: Smaller creators are strongest in loyal fans — but there was no way to prove it. motoo turns support, loyalty, and execution into a verifiable report.

insight.card1Body: Views and followers alone can't show whether a fandom is real.
insight.card2Body: Support records spread across platforms are never organized in one view.
insight.card3Body: Brands and MCNs demand trustworthy data before a collaboration.

creatorLanding.howTitle: Three steps from support to proof

how.step1Body: Payment goes directly to the creator via a licensed PG. The platform holds no funds.
how.step2Body: Care for regulars with the Backer Wall, founding badges, and perks — loyalty builds.
how.step3Title: Prove it with the Trust Report
how.step3Body: Share your monthly auto-compiled trust report with sponsors.

creatorLanding.reportBody: Five areas auto-compiled each month, shown as sponsor readiness. Manage deeply in a private dashboard, share cleanly in a public view.
creatorLanding.mochiExplainerBody: There is no refund of value, resale, or financial return. What you receive is your fans' heart and trust, and the data. Payment is delivered directly to the creator via a licensed PG.
